reasoning: The Psalms of David are canonical scripture translated into English innumerable times (KJV 1611, RSV 1952, NRSV 1990, NIV, ESV, etc.). NETS 2007 (Pietersma) specifically translates the Greek Septuagint—the direct textual ancestor of the Ge'ez Psalter—into complete modern English. A Ge'ez-specific English Psalter also exists via the Ethiopian Bible app. No 'first English translation' claim can stand for the Psalms.
